name: Dimensional Prophecy of Zohar Redux Layer 3: Porcupine Problems
source: Months after the Caine incident, mysterious couriers get killed in Kyoto Novalis. They transport a strange, extraterrestrial freight for an unknown recipient. This is a dark conspiracy which involves the Structures of the CFG institute. Meanwhile, Karala has her first day at her new school.
translation: 凯恩事件发生几个月后，神秘的信使在京都诺瓦利斯被杀。他们为未知的收件人运送奇怪的外星货物。这是一个涉及CFG机构的黑暗阴谋。与此同时，卡拉拉在新学校度过了第一天。
